_README: MACHINE-GENERATED DRAFT KAQCHIKEL — UNVALIDATED, NOT SAFE FOR USE. Produced by an AI that is NOT a reliable Kaqchikel speaker; it almost certainly contains errors in grammar, orthography, and medical terminology. It is a SEED for a native Kaqchikel speaker / Wuqu' Kawoq translator to rewrite and a clinician to re-approve before ANY field use. Keyed by audioKey (see docs/emergency-response/AUDIO.md); merged into the tree at load as the 'cak' text.
scene_safe: Tatz'eta' chawij. ¿La ütz richin yat'ok? (manäq q'aq', ch'ich', ch'a'oj, korriente, ya')
scene_ppe: Tak'ulu' ri guantes wakami. ¿La k'o guantes pa aq'a'?
scene_ppe_b: B. Manäq guantes — tachajij ri aq'a' (rik'in bolsa o tz'iek), k'a ri' tab'ana' samaj
scene_mechanism: ¿Achike xb'an chi re re winäq re'?
scene_mechanism_a: A. Sok o k'ayewal (xtzaq, choque, ch'ayoj, sokil)
scene_mechanism_b: B. Yab'il, manäq sok (q'oxom, q'aq', sutz'unïk, xtzaq pa ulew)
prim_responsive: Tachapa' ri telq'aj chuqa' tasik'ij: "¿La ütz at?" ¿La nsïl ri winäq?
prim_responsive_a: A. Ja' — nsilon, nch'on, o nujäq runaq'wäch
prim_airway_aware_b: B. Manäq — njik'on, nkamisäx ruxla', o k'o ruq'ajan
prim_airway_unresp: Ri winäq manäq nub'än. Tasilij ri jolomaj chi qiläl richin njäq ri b'ey ruxla'. Tatz'eta' pa chi' — ¿k'o jun natz'apin?
prim_airway_unresp_b: B. K'o jun ntz'apin (way, xa'ow, kik') — tawelesaj wi natz'ët
prim_airway_open: Tato'o' richin nuqupij ri'. ¿K'a nukamisaj na richin nuxla' chi rij ojob'?
prim_airway_open_b: B. Ja', k'a manäq nikowin nuxla'
prim_breathing: Tatz'eta' ri ruk'u'x 10 segundos. ¿La nuxla' ri winäq? (njote' ri ruk'u'x, nana' kaq'ïq')
prim_breathing_b: B. Anin, eqal, o k'ayew ri ruxlanik
prim_breathing_c: C. Manäq nuxla', o xa njik'on
prim_circulation: Tatz'eta' anin ronojel ri ch'akulaj. ¿K'o nïm kik' nel? (nmolotäj o nt'iqotäj)
prim_circulation_b: B. Ja' — taq'apij RUCHUQ'A' ri sok rik'in tz'iek, man tayä' kan
prim_disability: Tatz'eta' la k'as ri winäq. ¿Achike qitzij wakami?
prim_disability_b: B. Xa nk'astäj toq nasik'ij rik'in ruchuq'a'
sec_t_head: Tatz'eta' chuqa' tachapa' chi qiläl ri jolomaj chuqa' ri qul. ¿K'o jun chi re re'? (kik', nïm sipoj, b'olob'ïk, q'oxom pa qul)
sec_t_head_b: B. Ja', k'o k'ayewal pa jolomaj o qul — MAN tasilij ri qul
sec_t_chest: Tatz'eta' chuqa' tachapa' ri ruk'u'x. ¿La ütz nuk'utuj chuqa' junan nsilon toq nuxla'?
sec_t_chest_b: B. Manäq — sok, man junan ta nsilon, o k'ayew ruxlanik
sec_t_abdomen: Taq'apij chi qiläl ri pamaj. ¿La ch'uch'uj chuqa' manäq nïm q'oxom?
sec_t_abdomen_a: A. Ja', ch'uch'uj chuqa' manäq nïm q'oxom
sec_t_abdomen_b: B. Manäq — kowïk, sipoj, o k'o nïm q'oxom
sec_t_extremities: Tatz'eta' ri aq'a' chuqa' aqän. ¿K'o jun b'olob'ïk, nïm sok, o man nikowin ta nsilon?
sec_t_extremities_a: A. Ütz ri aq'a' chuqa' aqän
sec_t_extremities_b: B. Ja' — ntzu' q'ajinäq, nïm sok, o man nsilon ta
sec_t_spine: Tak'utuj: ¿La nana' chuqa' nikowin nasilij ri ruwi' aq'a' chuqa' aqän? (o tach'iro' chi qiläl chuqa' tatz'eta')
sec_t_spine_a: A. Ja', nuna' chuqa' nusilij ronojel
sec_t_spine_b: B. Manäq nuna' o manäq nsilon pa jun lugar
sec_m_conditions: Tak'utuj chi re ri winäq o ri rach'alal: ¿k'o jun yab'il retaman? (anima', azúcar, asma, sutz'unïk, alanïk)
sec_m_conditions_b: B. Ja', k'o jun yab'il retaman
sec_m_onset_b: B. Eqal, pa taq horas o q'ij
sec_m_complaint: ¿Achike ri NÏM k'ayewal nuna' ri winäq?
sec_m_complaint_a: A. Q'oxom pa ruk'u'x o k'ayew ruxlanik
sec_m_complaint_b: B. Ntzaq ruwäch, jun lado manäq ruchuq'a', o sachsöj ruch'ab'äl
sec_m_complaint_c: C. Nïm q'oxom, q'aq', o xa'ow
sec_m_complaint_d: D. Sutz'unïk, manäq ruchuq'a', o xtzaq
sec_m_vitals_breath: Tajila' ri ruxlanik 30 segundos, k'a ri' takamulaj. ¿Achike rub'anik ri ruxlanik?
sec_m_vitals_breath_b: B. Sib'iläj anin o sib'iläj eqal, o k'ayew
sec_m_vitals_pulse: Tana' ri pulso pa q'a' o pa qul. Tajila' 30 segundos, k'a ri' takamulaj. ¿Achike rub'anik ri pulso?
sec_m_vitals_pulse_b: B. Sib'iläj anin, eqal, o man kow ta
disp_unsafe_instructions: MAN katok. Tel pa jun ütz lugar naj. Tasik'ij to'ïk wakami. Ke'achajij ri chïk winäq. Xaxe katok toq xq'ax yan ri k'ayewal.
disp_cpr_instructions: Tasik'ij to'ïk de emergencia wakami. Tatz'ulu' ri winäq pa rij pa jun kow lugar. Taq'apij ruchuq'a' chuqa' anin pa runik'ajal ruk'u'x, achi'el 2 pa jun segundo. Man taq'ät kan k'a toq npe to'ïk o k'a toq nuxla' ri winäq. Wi awetaman chuqa' k'o DEA, tokisaj.
disp_immediate_instructions: Re' k'o pa k'ayewal ri k'aslem. Tak'waj WAKAMI — man koyob'ej, man taq'is ri chïk nik'oj. Taq'apij k'a ri kik'. Wi k'o sok pa qul/rij, tachajij ri jolomaj chuqa' man tasilij. Tab'ij chi re ri clínica chi yape rik'in jun yawa' k'o pa nïm k'ayewal. Tatz'eta' chïk ri ruxlanik pa b'ey.
disp_priority_instructions: Kab'iyin anin. Tachojmirisaj ri b'ey wakami chuqa' tasik'ij nab'ey richin ütz ri clínica. Ke'aya' ri winäq jub'ulüj, tz'uyul, chuqa' mäq'. Tatz'eta' ri ruxlanik chuqa' ri rk'astajem chi taq jujun ratzeq — wi nïm nub'än, tab'ana' achi'el wakami.
disp_stable_instructions: Ri winäq jik'ïl wakami. Taya' jub'ulüj chuqa' tatz'eta'. Tatz'eta' ri ruxlanik, pulso, chuqa' rk'astajem chi taq 5-10 minutos. Tachojmirisaj b'ey o seguimiento. Wi XABACHIKE nub'än k'ayew, tajote'isaj pa nabey o pa wakami.
